session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Gap Up then Spike and Channel Bull Trend Day'. Overnight ET+12: expanding triangle bottom near 7379 starts a spike and channel bull trend to 7448, a buy climax double top with Monday high at 7460 only buys a tight bear channel pullback to 7427, and the limit-order bull trending tight trading range grinds to 7460 into the close. Chart closes at 04:00 PT+12 print.
